CommunityApplications.Profile:
Templates for **Curacast**, which turns a Plex, Jellyfin or Emby library into 24/7 live TV channels with a real programme guide.
Curacast presents itself to Plex as an HDHomeRun tuner, so Plex Live TV discovers it automatically, and it serves M3U and XMLTV for any IPTV client. FFmpeg is bundled, with NVENC, VAAPI and QSV encoders. Images are published for `linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64`.
Two templates: the standard one, which can pass through an Intel or AMD GPU via `/dev/dri`, and an NVIDIA variant that runs the same image under the NVIDIA runtime for NVENC. NVENC has been verified encoding on real hardware.
Free for 14 days on up to 2 channels. A subscription removes the channel limit. Existing channels are never removed if a licence lapses, and a programme already playing is never interrupted.
Support: [curacast.tv/support](https://curacast.tv/support) or support@inertiatechgroup.com
